name: route
summary: The 4-op FM algorithm router (audio rate): a switch over the 8 shipped algorithm routings (weights 0/1, Q15 0/32767), outputting the modulation into op2/op3/op4 + the carrier sum — specialized instead of a runtime `fm1_route4` (16 multiplies + 16 table loads → a selective sum, bit-exact). The modulator outputs are ×2 (the operators' −12 dB headroom quarter-scales the FM depth; ×2 restores it to half scale without touching the per-operator feedback). (op1 = O1 is never externally modulated.)
